include(ExternalProject)

set(COMMON_CMAKE_ARGS
    "-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=${CMAKE_C_COMPILER}"
    "-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}"
    "-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}"
    "-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}"
    "-DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS=${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}"
    "-DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS=${CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS}"
    "-DCMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS=${CMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS}"
    "-DCMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME=${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}"
    "-DCMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR=${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}"
)

get_property(MULTI_CONFIG GLOBAL PROPERTY GENERATOR_IS_MULTI_CONFIG)

if(MULTI_CONFIG)
    list(APPEND COMMON_CMAKE_ARGS "-DCMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES=${CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES}")
else()
    set(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES "${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
    list(APPEND COMMON_CMAKE_ARGS "-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
endif()

foreach(CONFIG ${CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES})
    string(TOUPPER "_${CONFIG}" _CONFIG)
    list(APPEND COMMON_CMAKE_ARGS
        "-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS${_CONFIG}=${CMAKE_C_FLAGS${_CONFIG}}"
        "-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS${_CONFIG}=${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS${_CONFIG}}"
        "-DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS${_CONFIG}=${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS${_CONFIG}}"
        "-DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS${_CONFIG}=${CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS${_CONFIG}}"
        "-DCMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS${_CONFIG}=${CMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS${_CONFIG}}"
    )
endforeach()

set(DLL_TARGETS)

add_subdirectory(EABase)
add_subdirectory(EASTL)
add_subdirectory(SDL3)
add_subdirectory(vulkan-headers)
add_subdirectory(volk)

set(DLL_TARGETS ${DLL_TARGETS} PARENT_SCOPE)
